confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates use sparse [Numbeo data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Essaouira-Morocco), updated after July. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect their relationship to beer and [local drink-price ranges](https://essaouira.org/manger-sortir/bars-rooftops); licensed venues vary. Accommodation is a subjective July estimate, with considerable variation in private hostel rooms and hotel classifications.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Essaouira’s local prices and general knowledge of Moroccan coastal destinations such as Agadir, adjusted for a smaller city with summer tourism.
